subject: Re: Scheduling demo — timezone handoff & reschedule
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finsight.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: Scheduling demo — proposed windows and DST note

Hi Samir,

Thanks for the interest — excited to walk through Redwood Inference for the FinSight pipeline. A quick note up front: US daylight saving time kicks in on Mar 8 this year, while most EU countries change on Mar 29. That creates a one-hour offset window (US moved, EU not yet) that often trips up calendar invites, so I want to be explicit about offsets.

Two options that would keep things reasonable for your East Coast team and our EU engineers:

- Option A: 09:00 ET / 14:00 CET on Tue Mar 16 (mid-morning for you, early afternoon for our EU engineers)
- Option B: 17:00 ET / 22:00 CET on Tue Mar 16 (late afternoon for you, late evening for EU — we can keep this to 60 minutes)

If neither works, we can also push to the following week and have an APAC colleague (Ava) handle a later slot to make the overlap easier. I've attached a short demo agenda and a timezone conversion snapshot so we can lock the exact UTC offsets.

Proposed duration: 45 minutes + 15 Q&A. Also happy to split into a short product walkthrough and separate technical deep-dive if you prefer.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, timezone-conversion.png

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

From: Samir Patel <samir@finsight.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@dataserv.fr>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — proposed windows and DST note

Thanks, Rishi — and good catch on the DST timing. I forgot the US change already happened. For context, our core team will be on the East Coast (NY) and prefers morning times. The two options look close; Option A (09:00 ET) is best for us.

Quick ask: can we move the slot to Wed Mar 17 instead? Some stakeholders are in back-to-back calls on the 16th. If Wed 17 at 09:00 ET works for your EU engineers, that would be ideal. If not, we can take Option B on the 16th.

Also CC'ing Claire — she'll coordinate the calendar invite on our side.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Data Products, FinSight Analytics
samir@finsight.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finsight.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — proposed windows and DST note

On Tue, 10 Mar 2026 at 09:12:00 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the interest — excited to walk through Redwood Inference for the FinSight pipeline. A quick note up front: US daylight saving time kicks in on Mar 8 this year, while most EU countries change on Mar 29.
>
> Two options that would keep things reasonable for your East Coast team and our EU engineers:
> - Option A: 09:00 ET / 14:00 CET on Tue Mar 16
> - Option B: 17:00 ET / 22:00 CET on Tue Mar 16

Hi Samir — Wed Mar 17 at 09:00 ET / 14:00 CET works for our EU engineers. We're based in Amsterdam and will still be on CET (UTC+1) that week, so the 09:00 ET slot is 14:00 CET for us. I've confirmed availability from our technical lead (will join for the first 30m) and Rishi will run the demo.

Ava — since you have more flexible hours, can you be on standby in case we need a later follow-up for APAC stakeholders? If so, I'll send a single calendar invite for Wed Mar 17 09:00 ET and include a note about the UTC offsets so everyone's calendar shows the right time across timezones.

I'll create the calendar invite and include the attached agenda. Also adding a one-line note in the invite: "US DST began Mar 8; EU DST begins Mar 29 — confirm local time before joining." That reduces the chance of half-hour/one-hour mistakes.

Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions Engineering — EMEA
laura@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@finsight.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@dataserv.fr>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — proposed windows and DST note

Perfect — Wed Mar 17 at 09:00 ET / 14:00 CET works for us. Claire will send the invite from FinSight and include the proposed agenda. Looking forward to it.

Thanks for being explicit about the DST window — that saved time.

Samir
thread_content_summary: Cross-region demo scheduling with US customer (FinSight) and EU engineering team. Noted one-hour DST offset window; agreed to Wed Mar 17 09:00 ET / 14:00 CET. Attachments: demo agenda and timezone conversion. Calendar invite to be exchanged between teams.
